items.title: Empty output columns when processing timsTOF files
items.body:
The output files generated by GlyCounter v1.1.0 appear to be empty when processing Bruker .d files. For test purposes I also tried converted the file to mzML files using DataAnalysis.
The files are uploaded successfully and processing completes, but the generated output text files contain empty columns and no results.
An example is attached from the output generated by GlyCounter from a publicly available dataset, see below.
I observed this behavior with my own data (can be shared if needed) and with the publicly available dataset from PRIDE (PXD034845). I specifically used the file 20220228_TIMSTOF1_UM6_Mukhe004_EXT00_HumanPlasma250ng_Polygon_CE50_RA12_1_1655.d. Both my files and the example file produces output files with empty columns.
The data was either obtained on a timsTOF Pro (PRIDE data) or timsTOF fleX MALDI 2.

items.title: Oktoberfest fails if spectra file contains more than one dot
items.body:
Hi!

**Describe the bug**

I had a spectra file with two dots (say, foo.bar.mzML) and Oktoberfest fails because cannot find some intermediate file.

https://pastebin.com/7HshTDTN -- log
https://pastebin.com/zsRimguE -- config

msms directory has `20250729_EX1_UM1_Potte005_SA_EXT00_3hDDA_SKNAS_ACN_03.rescore  msms.prosit` files while Oktoberfest is looking for `20250729_EX1_UM1_Potte005_SA_EXT00_3hDDA_SKNAS_ACN_03.trimmed.rescore`.

Running the same pipeline but with `_trimmed` instead of `.trimmed` works fine.

**To Reproduce**

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
* Run oktoberfest with spectra file containing two or more dots.

**Expected behavior**

Pipeline does not fail

**System [please complete the following information]:**

Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS, Python 3.12.3, oktoberfest==0.10.0

items.title: feat(ui): Dialog·Select 프리미티브 + 갤러리 반영 (UM1)
items.body:
## 요약

- **의존성**: `@base-ui/react` 1.8.0(구 `@base-ui-components/react`는 rc 정지 — base-ui-over-shadcn 갱신 이력) · `lucide-react` 1.43.0. `@galley/ui` dependencies(정확 핀) + Vite external.
- **`"use client"` 보존**: Rollup이 지시어를 버리므로 `output.banner`로 번들 전체(ESM·CJS)에 1줄. 파일별 보존은 npm 배포 시 재검토(ui-package-boundary 확정 기록).
- **Dialog**: 제어형 open/onOpenChange · title=접근성 이름 · description·children·footer 슬롯 · trigger(Base UI render) · closeLabel. 포커스 트랩·Esc·바깥 클릭은 Base UI 기본. 토큰 `--ui-color-backdrop`·`--ui-dialog-width`·`--ui-control-height`.
- **Select**: 단일 제어형. `items: { value, label, description?, trailing?, disabled?, disabledReason? }`(도메인 무지). `disabledReason`은 Tooltip 전이라 native title.
- **갤러리 `/design`**: ListToolbar·ListRow(A5a에서 누락)·Dialog·Select 섹션 추가. 상태 데모는 `PrimitiveDemos.tsx`(client).
- worklog·todo(UM1 `[x]` 신설)·CLAUDE.md 스택 표 버전·decisions 갱신 이력.

## 검증

- TDD RED→GREEN. 테스트 12개 신규(ui 55 통과). 스토리 2파일.
- ui build 산출물 첫 줄 `"use client";` · Base UI 미번들 · d.ts export 확인. dashboard build 통과, 프로덕션 스모크 `/design` 200(새 섹션 4개 렌더).
- lint · typecheck(3 프로젝트) · prettier 통과.
- 테스트 함정: Base UI Item 선택은 `pointerdown → click` 순서 필요(테스트에 주석).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01T7hatn4VhTtz8E8QUNp7Vo
